briefdescription.para: Numerical homotopy-continuation path tracker for systems of polynomial equations.

detaileddescription.para: Holds two homotopy systems (H and the (S, T) start/target pair) plus their precomputed straight-line evaluators (slpH, slpHxt, slpHxtH, slpHxH, slpS, slpSx, ...), and tracks each input solution from S to T via a predictor-corrector loop. Supports projective tracking (is_projective) with Bombieri-Weyl arc length bigT along the great circle and ProjectiveNewton scaling via DMforPN. A static catalog[MAX_NUM_PATH_TRACKERS] lets the interpreter refer to a tracker by integer ID rather than by raw pointer.
